name: derainbow
what: removes the shimmering colour bands that composite video leaves on fine detail (ffmpeg dedot, cross-colour mode): where the colour of a pixel flips from frame to frame while its neighbours in time agree, it is averaged with them; the luma is untouched
when: fine black-and-white detail (hatching, text, striped clothes) shows colour bands that shimmer from frame to frame
softens: fast real colour changes in small areas (a blinking coloured light)
tried_on: none of the owner samples has this defect, so it was created artificially on an owner cartoon cut: colour stripes on luma edges flipping every frame: chroma error 1.90 -> 0.64 at the default settings, luma unchanged, guard passed. Higher thresholds were worse (0.96), and a motion-compensated chroma degrain did nothing (1.87). Not yet tried on a real composite source
